scope: Selected existing basic chart/drawing capabilities. This closes OM12 native profile, not all 1,220 Excel reference pages or the Medium stage. No new renderer, chart algorithm, drawing feature or service is required.

required_obligations.native_evidence: crates/model/src/features.rs::Chart; engine chart.* and object anchor commands
required_obligations.profile: Embedded native containers; live collections, source and settings; generated names are read-only. Blank charts and chart sheets have no native model/service. Location supports transfer to existing worksheets; native owner synchronization retains parked descendants across adapter or external chart moves. Protection and destination ID collisions refuse before transfer.

Same-workbook bounded ranges and scalar arrays. Add infers labels/categories; explicit label overrides, Extend, blank NewSeries and writable SERIES formula strings refuse. PlotOrder preserves element identity. Native shared series fill/line color; no per-point/marker styling.

Native trendline families; forecast/intercept/equation/name; indexed edit/delete and native line color, width 0.25..12 and represented dash styles. Maximum 16 trendlines per series. No independent equation DataLabel formatting state.

Automatic Cartesian axes/plot layout; primary titles/value gridlines; computed auto scales read-only. Data labels show formatted values with chart-wide enablement. Per-series enablement only for one-series charts. Manual scales/layout, log/time axes, per-label edits and independent area/gridline/font styling have no stored native state.

Ordinary native shapes, textboxes, lines and embedded pictures; placement/geometry, generated read-only names, OnAction for native shapes, layer-relative z-order. ShapeRange snapshots up to 256 handles, common-origin translations, align within one native layer, deletion; collective scaling refuses. Pictures use explicit regular-file paths on native hosts, embedded media only; browser filesystem service refusal is explicit. Original-size -1 picture dimensions use existing decoded header dimensions; unsupported line direction flips refuse.

required_obligations.native_evidence: model::ShapeFormat; shape.setText and chart.shapeFill/Outline; native shape renderer/XLSX
required_obligations.profile: Textboxes support UTF-16 Characters slices and one whole-body font/alignment/reading order; Office TextFrame2/TextRange2/Font2 plus solid fill/outline colors. Partial font runs, margins/autosize/gradient/effects/transparency and arbitrary line widths for ordinary shapes lack native state. Font2 outline uses existing native text_outline. Shared FillFormat/LineFormat/ColorFormat/TextFrame2 accept both documented Excel and Office nominal aliases.

native_capability_exclusions.surface: ChartObjects.Add / SeriesCollection.NewSeries / Charts / chart-sheet Location, Activate, window/selection members
native_capability_exclusions.reason: insert.chart requires data-backed series. No blank charts, chart-sheet model or chart selection/window service.
No persistent group/connector model. arrange.group only aligns anchors, so it cannot implement Group/Ungroup.

native_capability_exclusions.surface: Chart.Export / chart/shape Copy, Cut, CopyPicture, Paste, Duplicate
native_capability_exclusions.reason: No chart-only export, floating-object clipboard or object duplication service. Existing range clipboard transfers range cell content only. Native XLSX persistence and workbook render/export continue to render native models.

native_capability_exclusions.surface: Chart.Shapes / independent ChartGroup, Point, LegendEntry, labels, axes, plot/chart/title fonts and effects
native_capability_exclusions.reason: Native chart stores series plus chart-wide options; no independent child style/selection/group/point/effect objects. The projection exposes represented titles/axes/labels and automatic layout, without fabricating editable child state.

Native standalone sparklines have source/cell/kind/color/markers; no SparklineGroup/axis/point object model. Range.SparklineGroups belongs to OM06 and remains outside its accepted native profile; native insert.sparkline is unchanged.

native_capability_exclusions.surface: 3-D chart options / external provider or PivotLayout / deprecated drawing surfaces
native_capability_exclusions.reason: No corresponding existing native state or service; local pivots belong to OM13.
